Your Itinerary

Thursday 15th October

Our first day in the sun! We'll arrive around midday so there will be plenty of beers around the pool, followed by a sunset dinner and cocktails on our Penthouse Terrace to kick off the trip! We'll then hit up the Américas strip and see where the night takes us... Most likely to the world's best Irish pub where you'll be singing your heart out till 4 AM. You know what they say about the first night...

Friday 16th October

A fun day out to Siam Park, Europe's best water park! Take on the Tower of Power, a vertical drop through an Aquarium tunnel or race each other round the high speed water coaster and racing slides. For those feeling more on the delicate side, you can float your way down Mai Thai, the world's longest Lazy River. 🌊

Visit Website →

Thrilling Slides
Paradise Pools

Saturday 17th October

On Saturday we'll celebrate in style with Ocean views and poolside tunes at Las Rocas Beach Club! Bali beds cost approx €75 euros each which includes €50 credit towards food and drink on the day.

Typical prices: House Wine / Local Draft Beer €4-6 / Sangria €7 / Pizzas €16-€20

Sunday 18th October - Boat Day!

As a special thanks for joining us for our big celebrations, Tab & I are hiring a private boat for the day, complete with its own water slide! We'll bring our own booze and our own tunes, so get your playlist suggestions at the ready! There's also Kayaks, Paddle boards and Snorkel Equipment to help keep our minds off the hangover 🤪

We're saving the best til last here! However please note capacity is limited to 12 people, so please let us know ASAP if you are planning to stay for the full trip so we can reserve your spot!

Monday 19th October

After all that excitement, we'll have a recovery day at either the Parque Santiago or Beach Club Pool. We'll have a final lunch together and some time to enjoy a bit more sun before heading home around 4 PM with some amazing and perhaps slightly hazy memories! 🍹😎
